name: @systems-suite/aether
description: High-throughput WebGPU Terminal Emulator with pure Rust VT100/ANSI parser

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && mkdir -p public/wasm && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/aether_core.wasm public/wasm/aether_core.wasm
scripts.test: pnpm test:cargo && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:bench
